title: 第一卷 第13章 太祖法旨第一卷 第14章 挖了柳家祖坟
lines: 看到秦渊走进来，元昊急忙开口。
“秦渊，你来得正好，快叫秦玄赶紧放手，这位赵家少主的身份可是非比寻常，他要是有个三长两短，秦家怕是会有大麻烦。”
听着元昊的话，秦渊看向秦玄，看到秦玄没有受伤，秦渊这才松了口气。
“玄儿，没事吧？”
秦玄笑着点了点头。
“爷爷放心，我没什么事情，只是......”
秦玄将视线投向赵龙腾，显然是在征询秦渊的意见。
虽然现在自己随时可以置对方于死地。
可对方的威胁他自然是有所顾忌的。
他不能不管秦家的死活。
“秦玄，赶紧放人，不然你们秦家全都要给他赵家少主陪葬！”
柳生在一旁大喊着。
虽然秦玄意外击败了赵龙腾让他颇为意外。
可他也明白要是赵龙腾死在柳家，就算不是他们杀的，这件事和他们也脱不了干系。
话音刚落，秦渊冷冷看了眼柳生。
“聒噪！这里没有你说话的份！”
此时的柳生仗着之前赵龙腾的话，没有把秦家放在眼里。
在他看来，秦玄和秦家根本就不敢真的对赵龙腾下手。
“哼，我劝你们秦家还是识相点，赶紧放人，要是腾龙少主有个三长两短，你们秦家都不够给腾龙少主陪葬......”
柳生话音未落，秦渊朝着身后一个长老使了个眼色。
这个长老会意，一巴掌直接将柳生扇飞了出去。
“再敢多嘴，割了你的舌头！”
秦渊看向秦玄。
“爷爷，这人该如何处置，他是玄龙道赵家少主......”
秦玄皱着眉头询问。
听到这话，赵龙腾也是松了口气。
他最怕对方是个愣头青，既然对方对自己的身份有顾忌，那就好办！
“哼，都知道我的身份了，还不赶紧松手？”
“不然，到时候你们秦家鸡犬不留......”
话音未落，秦玄冷着脸，无锋剑立即朝着赵龙腾的一条胳膊剁了下去。
“咔嚓！”
随着一阵骨骼碎裂的声音，赵龙腾的一条胳膊被秦玄给打断，硬生生地扯了下来。
“你，快停手！”
一旁的杨老脸色顿时一片铁青。
他没想到，到了这时候，他还敢对赵龙腾动手。
“玄儿，你放手去做，不用担心我们！”
content_en:
Seeing Qin Yuan walking in, Yuan Hao hurriedly spoke.
"Qin Yuan, you are here at the right time. Tell Qin Xuan to let go immediately. The identity of this young master of the Zhao family is extraordinary. If he has any shortcomings, the Qin family may be in big trouble."
After listening to Yuan Hao's words, Qin Yuan looked at Qin Xuan and was relieved when he saw that Qin Xuan was not injured.
"Xuan'er, are you okay?"
Qin Xuan smiled and nodded.
"Grandpa, don't worry, there's nothing wrong with me, it's just..."
Qin Xuan turned his attention to Zhao Longteng, obviously seeking Qin Yuan's opinion.
Although now he can kill the other party at any time.
But he naturally had scruples about the other party's threats.
He couldn't care less about the Qin family's life or death.
"Qin Xuan, let him go quickly, otherwise all of you in the Qin family will be buried with him, the young master of the Zhao family!"
Yagyu shouted from the side.
Although Qin Xuan unexpectedly defeated Zhao Longteng, which surprised him.
But he also understood that if Zhao Longteng died in the Liu family, even if they were not the ones to kill him, they would still have something to do with it.
As soon as he finished speaking, Qin Yuan looked at Liu Sheng coldly.
"Noisy! You have no place to speak here!"
At this time, Liu Sheng relied on Zhao Longteng's words before and did not take the Qin family seriously.
In his opinion, Qin Xuan and the Qin family did not dare to really attack Zhao Longteng.
"Hmph, I advise you, the Qin family, to be wise and release him immediately. If there is anything wrong with Young Master Tenglong, your Qin family won't even have enough money to bury Young Master Tenglong with him..."
"Crack!"
Before Liu Sheng finished speaking, Qin Yuan winked at an elder behind him.
The elder understood this and sent Yagyu flying away with a slap.
"If you dare to talk too much, I'll cut your tongue!"
Qin Yuan looked at Qin Xuan.
"Grandpa, what should we do with this man? He is the young master of the Zhao family of Xuanlong Dao..."
Qin Xuan asked with a frown.
Hearing this, Zhao Longteng also breathed a sigh of relief.
He is most afraid that the other party is a stupid young man. Since the other party has scruples about his identity, it will be easy to handle!
"Hmph, you already know my identity, why don't you let go quickly?"
"Otherwise, your Qin family's chickens and dogs will not be left alive..."
Before he finished speaking, Qin Xuan had a cold face and immediately chopped off one of Zhao Longteng's arms with his sharp sword.
"Crack!"
With the sound of bones breaking, one of Zhao Longteng's arms was broken by Qin Xuan and torn off forcefully.
"You, stop it!"
Mr. Yang's face suddenly turned pale.
He didn't expect that at this time, he would dare to attack Zhao Longteng.
"Xuan'er, just go ahead and do it, don't worry about us!"
